title: Need for Speed: Most Wanted (2005)
provenance: Reported by balumn (highball-db#425, 2026-10-09), Apple M4, macOS 26.2, Highball 0.9.35, engine x64-crossover26.3-r9, Wine's own Direct3D (wined3d), rated 5 of 5 after 40 minutes, no Steam app id given. Not verified by the maintainer. TheErondu (highball-db#1225, 2026-11-15), Apple M1, macOS 26.7.2, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXVK, rated 5 of 5 after 3 minutes: named speed in the report's title, the game named in the report a minute later. The copy isn't stated. In the player's words the game didn't run until Emulate display mode changes was checked.
notes: Reported perfect on Wine's own Direct3D over a 40-minute session on an M4 with the Wine 11 engine r9. Whether the default DXMT mode also works is not recorded, so the page sets no mode. Also reported perfect on DXVK on a base M1 with the default engine (r28) in a 3 minute session, and the player says it only ran with Emulate display mode changes checked (highball-db#1225).

knownIssues.symptom: Doesn't run unless Emulate display mode changes is checked, in the player's words (M1, Wine 10 r28, DXVK, highball-db#1225)
knownIssues.fix: check Emulate display mode changes, as the reporter did
